detail.longDescription: 🎞️ DaVinci Resolve: a new refined easy Linux install Flatpak 📦 This one has a Qt-based installer that downloads / installs DaVinci Resolve *on-demand*. Such on-demand type method allows legal distribution on Flathub (a universal Linux app store), while still providing a convenient user experience. ◉ Launcher endpoints for all DaVinci Resolve apps ◉ Automatic installation / update prompts ◉ Support for both Free / Studio versions Please help on testing 🙏 👉 https:// github.com/night199uk/resolve- flatpak/releases # DaVinciResolve # Linux # flatpak # videoediting # software # packages # MIT # GitHub
